chapter.verse: Singkung lopa a sel hunin, Topa ’ kiang pan guah ngen un. Meii kaisakin, guah zusak a, ankung khempeuh a dumsakpa in Topa ahi hi.

Mihingte in milim peuh, thudotin nei uh a, a thu ngahte uh, zuauthu leh a mawkna hi lel hi. Mang khia thei-a kineite in lamlak khial uh a, amau’ hehnepnate, a mawknapi hi lel hi. Tua ahih manin, tuu bangin mite mangthang uh a, makai a neih loh manun gimna ngah uh hi.
Ka mi a makaite tungah ka heh suak a, amaute daan ka pia ding hi. Judah mite in, Vanglianpen Topa ahi keima aa hi a, amaute lim takin keemin, ka sakol galkap thahatte hi ding uh hi.
Amaute sung panin innkiu suang khetphim galkap mangte, gam ukte, hong khangkhia ding uh hi.
Kongzing buannawng lakah, a galte a tuancil gawp galkapte bangin, amaute gualzo ding uh a, Topa in a ompih manin amaute in galdo ding uh a, a galte’ sakol galkapte zo gawp ding uh hi.

Judah mite, ka thahatsak ding a, Josef’ innkuan ka honkhia ding hi. Amaute ka khasiat ding a, innah ka ciahpih kik ding hi. Amaute cik mah-a ka nial ngei loh bang keekin, nuam takin om ding uh hi. Keimah in Topa, amau’ Pasian ka hi a, amau’ thungetnate ka pia ding hi.
Israel mite’ galkap hatte bang ding uh a, zukham lungnuam, bang ding uh hi. A suan a khakte un hih gualzawhna phawkin lungdam ding uh a, Topa ’ bawlna hangin kipak ding uh hi.
Amaute samin, ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute honkhia-in, ni danga zahin mi tampi ka phasak ding hi.
Mi namdangte lakah amaute ka thehthang hangin, a gamlapi gam panin kei hong phawk ding uh hi. Amaute leh a tate uh suakta-in, innah hong ciahkhawm ding uh hi.
Izipt leh Assiria gam panin amaute ka ciahpih kik ding a, amau’ gam amau’ lei-ah ka teengsak ding hi. Gilead gam leh Lebanon gamah zong ka teengsak ding a, gam khempeuhah mi dim ding hi.
Amaute in, lungkhamna tuipi a phutkhak uh ciangin, keimah in tuipi hualte ka vatmai ding a, Nail gun tuithukte kangcip ding hi. Assiria mite ka niamkhiat ding a, Izipt in a vangliatna taan ding hi.
Ka mite ka thahatsak ding a, amaute in kei hong bia-in ka thu hong mang ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi.
